subject: german
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.explain: 'Der Verein' means 'a club/society', e.g. 'der Sportverein' = sports club.

questions.q: How do you say 'My throat hurts'?
questions.explain: 'Halsschmerzen' = 'a sore throat'; 'Kopf' = head and 'Bauch' = stomach are the distractors.
'Vermeiden' = 'to avoid' and 'Süßigkeiten' = 'sweets', so this is 'I avoid sweets'.

questions.q: What does 'ausgewogen' mean (e.g. of a diet)?
questions.explain: 'Ausgewogen' means 'balanced', as in 'eine ausgewogene Ernährung' = 'a balanced diet'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I find that film boring'?
questions.explain: 'Langweilig' = 'boring'; 'spannend' (exciting) and 'lustig' (funny) are distractors.

questions.q: What does 'Ich bekomme ein Geschenk' mean?
questions.explain: False friend: 'bekommen' means 'to get/receive', not 'to become'. 'To become' is 'werden'.
'Die Nachrichten' means 'the news' (TV/radio); singular 'eine Nachricht' = a message.

questions.q: What does 'sich verkleiden' mean at carnival?
questions.explain: 'Sich verkleiden' means 'to dress up in costume/fancy dress', common at carnival.
'Die Gesundheit' means 'health'; from 'gesund' = healthy.
'Gesund' means 'healthy'; the opposite is 'ungesund' (unhealthy).
'Der Bildschirm' means 'the screen'. ('Der Schirm' alone can mean umbrella — a near-miss.)
'Verheiratet' means 'married'; 'verlobt' = engaged and 'geschieden' = divorced.

questions.q: How do you say 'I spend too much time on my phone'?
options: Ich verbringe wenig Zeit am Handy
Ich verbringe zu viel Zeit am Handy
Ich brauche zu viel Zeit am Handy
Ich verbringe zu viel Zeit im Bett
questions.explain: 'Zu viel Zeit verbringen' = 'to spend too much time' and 'am Handy' = 'on the phone'.
'Witzig' means 'funny/witty' (from 'der Witz' = joke).
'Ein Sänger' is a male singer (female: 'eine Sängerin'); 'a song' is 'ein Lied'.
'Der Faschingsdienstag' is Shrove Tuesday, the peak day of carnival before Lent.
'Sich streiten' means 'to argue/quarrel', e.g. with a sibling.
'Karneval' (also 'Fasching'/'Fastnacht') is the carnival season before Lent.

questions.q: How do you say 'We give each other presents at Christmas'?
options: Wir bekommen keine Geschenke zu Weihnachten
Wir kaufen uns Geschenke zu Ostern
Wir schenken uns nichts zu Weihnachten
Wir schenken uns Geschenke zu Weihnachten
questions.explain: 'Schenken' = 'to give (as a gift)' and 'zu Weihnachten' = 'at Christmas'.

questions.q: What does 'die Vorstellung' mean (at the theatre/cinema)?
questions.explain: 'Die Vorstellung' means 'the performance/showing' at a theatre or cinema.

questions.q: What does 'Ich lese normalerweise abends' mean?
options: I will read in the evenings
I have to read in the evenings
I used to read in the evenings
I usually read in the evenings
questions.explain: 'Normalerweise' means 'usually' and 'abends' = 'in the evenings', so this is 'I usually read in the evenings'.
'Berühmt' means 'famous', e.g. 'Er ist berühmt für seine Musik' = 'He is famous for his music'.
